newsitem.title: USA: Mobil Corp says fire at Calif. refinery.
newsitem.headline: Mobil Corp says fire at Calif. refinery.

text.p: Mobil Corp said on Thursday a fire broke out at its 130,000 barrel-per-day refinery in Torrance, Calif.
"There is a fire. We have not determined where it is," a plant employee said.
No further details were immediately available.
The Torrance refinery lies about 20 miles southwest of downtown Los Angeles.
Local television station KNBC said there was one injury at the site but the report could not be confirmed.
The blaze is the second fire in the Los Angeles-area in the last 10 days.
On November 11, a fire broke out at Texaco's 98,000 barrel-per-day refinery in Wilmington, Calif., another suburb south of Los Angeles.
